title: Payouts: freshness and correctness
description: The payout path fails differently from the payment path: the API can be perfectly healthy while no money moves. Both panels here are about work that is not happening rather than requests that are failing.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Depth alone is not an alert. A spike drains.

panels.title: Queue slope over 15 minutes
panels.description: Depth plus a positive slope for fifteen minutes is a queue that will not catch up. That pair is the alert.

panels.title: Payouts in a non final state over 15 minutes old
panels.description: Level 12. Every unit on this graph is a merchant debited for a payment that has not happened. The objective is zero and there is no budget.
